notes: Independent C4 round-1 critique; no production file in art-drop/out/city17 was edited. Reviewed BRIEF-17 in full, NOTES drawing/registration/reduction methods, both panel briefs, cycle-4 FIXES and all five reviews, plus critic-r17E-4. Scope: all 83 C4-manifest PNG exports, compose.py, all seven requested final renders and supporting acceptance proofs. Every new export was inspected at literal 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x (21 critic contact sheets); the full city was examined natively and in sixteen 4x tiles, with 8x defect close-ups. Inspected reference/r17 houses, halls and stalls and neighbouring approved art. Props/actors/signs were inspected over summer grass and workyard paving. Seven used ground types were inspected in literal 3x3 repeats at 1x/4x. No seasonal exports are part of C4, so summer/seasonal mask and seasonal-ground tests are not applicable; all 14 colour partners have alpha masks identical to their source. Independent technical checks passed: all 83 sizes and SHA256 values match the C4 manifest; alpha is only 0/255; transparent RGB is zero; no detached 1–2-pixel 8-connected alpha islands; affected facade/return course rows 0/47 match their fixed donors. Replayed 11,517,952 8x8 RGBA mode samples across 35 registered components with zero mismatches, and checked source hashes. This supports the required image-tool drawing/registration/mode-reduction method; no procedural substitute drawing is alleged. Fresh read-only composition equals the submitted final. Final is 1920x1440 (40x30 cells at 48 px); 2x is exact nearest-neighbour, squint is exact L conversion, all three 3x crops are exact, and the today/r15/C4 comparison panels preserve their native pixels. The later coordinator cell dimensions govern the approximate earlier 1200x900 target. Ground repeats are sharp and sufficiently quiet; no new ground-seam failure was found. Height count: 46 modular buildings: {1:7, 2:16, 3:15, 4:6, 5:2}, hence 15.22% one-storey. Including four lean-tos, stable range and market hall gives 52 structures: {1:13, 2:16, 3:15, 4:6, 5:2}, exactly 25.00% one-storey. This criterion passes. No exposed frontage lawns remain in the examined final; churchyard/workyard paving is improved. Six stalls, fountain/cross and visible townsfolk keep the square populated. The new gate-road plan is a real layout change, with bends/steps, mixed heights, an adjacent inn, slate northeast merchant roofs, brown poor-quarter roofs and uneven towers. Do not discard those gains. Repetition: rerunning the submitted C4 audit gives 233 instances, 219 visible, 149 scanned windows, 163 chains, no reported failures. Part E regression layouts likewise report no failures (L-block 39 instances/20 windows; market 61/24; height 32/12), and the three roof-back caps / eight forced shop fronts are repaired. The audit inventory omissions described under compose.py prevent a universal anywhere-in-the-scene pass; they are not evidence of a newly measured excess. FIXES coverage: 1 partial (east connector and separated gate layers good, west bypass remains); 2 partial (same-base order/NW duplicate/south spacing improved, east tower ownership fails); 3 fail (wrong-facing south/east enclosure); 4 visually addressed (continuous lighter bent 96 px arrival road, guard moved), but actual entrance validity is still limited by 3/13; 5 partial (bends/T/steps present, side elevations and serviced property edges incomplete); 6 addressed for the new ordinary facade modules and complete-house comparison; 7 partial (painted returns replace flat fill, complete side elevations/flashing fit incomplete); 8 fail (junction/adapters); 9 partial (colour improved, pitch/beads still fail); 10 fail (complete bounded rear-yard sequences); 11 addressed (paved enclosures and western court opening); 12 addressed for supplied sharp hall/gate shade, with joins still governed by 2/8; 13 partial (new inn door/arch readable, square entrance metadata contradicts paint); 14 partial (eight readable dark-rim signs pass as assets, mounting overlaps fail); 15 fail (incomplete placed-instance inventory); 16 partial (new grounds/storeys/parapets present, pasted tower/side variants fail); 17 visibly improved districts/work/inn storage; 18 partial (proof suite exists but accepts observed failures and uses an old middle hip); 19 addressed (east loading destination/clear west strip/marker); 20 new side/back/seated/porter actors supplied and visible, but full access acceptance depends on the unresolved architectural approaches.
